clues.it: Giada era accanto a un carro e a uno sgabello da saloon.
clues.en: Giada was beside a wagon and a saloon stool.

clues.it: Anna era nella 2ª riga e da sola all'Emporio, ma non era accanto a un abbeveratoio.
clues.en: Anna was in the 2nd row and alone in the General Store, but was not beside a water trough.

clues.it: Dario era nella 3ª riga e in Banca, ma non era accanto a un abbeveratoio.
clues.en: Dario was in the 3rd row and in the Bank, but was not beside a water trough.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 3ª colonna e accanto a un cavallo, ma non era accanto a un carro.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 3rd column and beside a horse, but was not beside a wagon.

clues.it: Luca era nella 5ª riga, a nord di Marta e nelle Stalle.
clues.en: Luca was in the 5th row, north of Marta and in the Stables.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 2ª colonna, nella 6ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Marta.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 2nd column, in the 6th row and in the same room as Marta.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Marta non era accanto a una cassaforte.
clues.en: Marta was not beside a safe.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 9ª colonna e nelle Stalle, ma non era accanto a un pianoforte.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 9th column and in the Stables, but was not beside a piano.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

general_clues.it: 1 accanto a uno sgabello da saloon.

steps.it: L'indizio di Giada lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Giada's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 8th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 6th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno lascia una sola casella libera: riga 6ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Bruno's own clue leaves a single free square: row 6th, column 2nd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 9ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 9th, column 9th.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 2ª riga: escludendola, a Fabio resta una sola casella: riga 4ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 2nd row: ruling it out leaves Fabio a single square: row 4th, column 3rd.

steps.it: Bruno può stare solo nella 2ª colonna: escludendola, a Dario resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Bruno can only be in the 2nd column: ruling it out leaves Dario a single square: row 3rd, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «1 accanto a un cactus» non torna senza Marta: deve stare in riga 8ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: The general clue “1 beside a cactus” cannot add up without Marta: they must be at row 8th, column 4th.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 persone nel Saloon» non torna senza Vito: deve stare in riga 7ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 people in the Saloon” cannot add up without Vito: they must be at row 7th, column 7th.
